WITH date_dim_2001 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_cd1 AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk,
           cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
cd2 AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
),
customer_matching AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_birth_year,
           ca.ca_country,
           ca.ca_state,
           ca.ca_county
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN cd2
      ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       cm.ca_country,
       cm.ca_state,
       cm.ca_county,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg1,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg2,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg3,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg4,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg5,
       AVG(CAST(cm.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg6,
       AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg7
FROM customer_matching cm
JOIN catalog_sales cs
  ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cm.c_customer_sk
JOIN date_dim_2001 dd
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_cd1 AS cd1
  ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN item i
  ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, cm.ca_country, cm.ca_state, cm.ca_county)
ORDER BY cm.ca_country, cm.ca_state, cm.ca_county, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
